A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GenExam benchmark. The main text, tables, figures, scoring definitions, and complete Appendices A–F are available and can be matched reliably despite pagination and layout changes.

before.justification: v4 reports original model evaluations, human-alignment measurements, evaluator ablations, and qualitative error analyses in Section 4 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v5 retains those original empirical studies and reports revised benchmark scores and additional Seedream 4.0 results.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction and evaluation framework remain unchanged: sample-specific scoring points, reference images, GPT-5 judging, and strict and relaxed scoring. Appendices B and E retain the same procedures and prompts.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 1,000-sample, ten-subject GenExam benchmark and GenExam-Mini subset. The subject taxonomy, source datasets, image types, and difficulty coverage are unchanged, including the appendix breakdowns.

E2.justification: v5 adds Seedream 4.0 alongside Seedream 4.5 in the full-benchmark comparison in Table 2 and GenExam-Mini comparison in Table 6(a). All previously evaluated comparators remain. Seedream 4.0's existing bibliography entry in v4 did not constitute participation in these comparisons.

E3.justification: The documented scoring criteria and weights, GPT-5 low-reasoning evaluator, default generation configurations, subset construction, and human-evaluation design are unchanged. The revised numerical results are not accompanied by a reported protocol change or statement that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The evaluator and reference-input ablations, human-alignment analyses, difficulty and image-type analyses, and qualitative error cases are retained unchanged. Revised GenExam-Mini scores do not introduce a new ablation or robustness question.

E5.justification: Tables 3–5 retain the same correlation statistics, p-values, significance flags, and standard-deviation reporting. Neither version adds seed information, repeated-run counts, or a new uncertainty-estimation procedure.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises many overall scores and a few subject-level entries: Nano Banana Pro's strict score changes from 72.7% to 70.2%, and GPT-Image-1.5's from 43.2% to 42.5%. Table 6(a) also changes scores, reversing GPT-Image-1 versus Seedream 4.5 on strict scoring, from 12.0 versus 12.2 to 12.6 versus 12.0. Seedream 4.0 results are added. These limited numerical revisions preserve the main findings.

T1.justification: The scoring definitions and mathematical conditions are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises a theorem, proof, formal assumption, or derivation.

C1.justification: Both versions claim the first multidisciplinary text-to-image exam benchmark, customized scoring, substantial benchmark difficulty, and a large closed-source/open-source performance gap. Revised headline percentages do not change the scope or meaning of these contributions.

C2.justification: The explanations concerning rendering failures, translating disciplinary knowledge into visual outputs, and reference images' spatial-detail advantages remain unchanged. No substantive applicability boundary, failure explanation, or limitation is added or removed.

D1.justification: Data-curation instructions, annotation procedures, evaluator prompts, inference disclosures, evaluator cost/time information, and the benchmark/code release statement and link remain unchanged. The added comparator receives no additional implementation documentation.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds citations to InternVL-U, GRADE, BizGenEval, and RISE-Video while retaining the existing research positioning. Numerous other reference changes update publication venues or years for the same works and do not represent new research coverage.

P1.justification: Section 2.2 gains a short introductory passage and paragraph restructuring. The running title, correspondence information, publication footer, and bibliographic metadata are updated. The overall section sequence and appendix organization remain stable.

P2.justification: Table 1 and Figure 3 move from page 4 to page 5, with associated text reflow. Tables 2 and 6(a) gain a comparator row, and Table 6(a) reorders some rows. Existing figures and appendix displays are retained without substantive redesign.

improvement.justification: Several revised Table 2 totals better match the published subject counts and the stated percentage-of-images definition: weighting the subject scores yields Nano Banana Pro's 70.2% and GPT-Image-1.5's 42.5%, matching v5. This improves numerical consistency, while Seedream 4.0 modestly broadens comparison. The revisions remain unexplained, and the unchanged '17 models' statement and baseline list omit the added comparator, limiting the overall gain.
